articles.title: Hardcovers - Dungeon Crawler Carl Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The first physical edition of the Dungeon Crawler Carl books was a paperback version that Matt Dinniman self-published alongside the eBook. The series
articles.body:
The first physical edition of the Dungeon Crawler Carl books was a paperback version that Matt Dinniman self-published alongside the eBook. The series didn't get an actual hardcover edition until more recently, following the publishing rights being acquired by Penguin Random House in 2024. The first official hardcover was released in August 2024. The latest book, A Parade of Horribles , was the first in the series to get all formats released at once.

In addition to the standard hardcovers, there's also a Deluxe Edition of the first book up for preorder. It officially releases on November 17, 2026 and will likely be followed by other Deluxe Editions later on. Here are the official details from the product page:

A stunning cover and artwork by acclaimed artist Victo Ngai

A fully illustrated hardcover case featuring a solvable maze

Illustrations on the inside of the jacket

A 4-color printed ribbon marker featuring Carl and Donut on the run

A Q&A with author Matt Dinniman, conducted by GC, BWR, NW Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk herself

If you're looking to buy the Dungeon Crawler Carl hardcover editions, you should be able to find them available at pretty much any online bookstore . The popularity of the series means you should be able to find copies at your local bookstore or Barnes & Noble as well. If you're looking for the overall best place to get a discount, Amazon is the way to go.

The best time to buy books in general is when Amazon has some sort of special promotion. The most recent example of this is the '3 for 2' sale on books the retailer offered for Prime Day 2026 , which included almost all of the DCC hardcovers.

articles.title: Anton Godwin's Jester Hat - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Anton Godwin is an NPC in Enshrouded and he lost his prized Jester Hat somewhere along the line. In this quest, you'll be tasked with finding and
articles.body:
Anton Godwin is an NPC in Enshrouded and he lost his prized Jester Hat somewhere along the line. In this quest , you'll be tasked with finding and recovering the fun hat. If you want to know how to trigger Anton Godwin's Jester Hat or where to find the hat itself, we've got everything you need to know in this Enshrouded guide.

Anton Godwin's Jester Hat is sitting in a chest inside a small settlement called New Cromville in the Albaneve Summits. This region is northwest of the Albaneve Ancient Spire, and has been completely swallowed up by the Shroud.

Most of the enshrouded areas in the Albaneve Summits are in deep valleys surrounded by mountains, and New Cromville is no different. To get there, fast travel to the Albaneve Ancient Summit and head northwest until you pass by the Event Honor Hall .

That's about the halfway point, so continue northwest from there, and eventually, you will find yourself on a massive cliff overlooking an enshrouded valley below. You will be able to spot some tower tops poking out from the Shroud. That's New Cromville.

Soar down there and reach the settlement entrance. Stand in front of the door and look up and to your right to spot a grapple point. Haul yourself up there and turn left immediately to find a long passage way. Go all the way to the end and turn around to spot another grapple point.

Walk forward to find a silver chest containing Anton Godwin's Jester Hat and complete your quest. There is also a lore page on the right called All Preparations are Done , which gives you some more background information on the hat.

articles.title: Oscar Godwin's Cousin - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Oscar Godwin's Cousin is an Enshrouded side quest that sends you on a mission to rescue Oscar Godwin's cousin, Anton Godwin. Anton Godwin has his own
articles.body:
Oscar Godwin's Cousin is an Enshrouded side quest that sends you on a mission to rescue Oscar Godwin's cousin, Anton Godwin. Anton Godwin has his own quests for you to embark on, like Anton Godwin's Jester Hat , for example, so saving him should definitely be on your to-do list. If you'res struggling to find Anton Godwin, we've got everything you need in this Enshrouded guide.

Oscar Godwin's cousin, A.K.A. Anton Godwin, is trapped in a prison cell in the Gateway Outpost "Drifa" . This is a large outpost that's been completely overrun by Vukah and Scavengers. You can find it on the path leading from the Kindlewastes to the Albaneve Summits Ancient Spire, so either make your way there to reach the outpost, or glide southeast from the Albaneve Summits Ancient Spire.

Once you reach the Gateway Outpost "Drifa", head inside to the main hall and defeat all the enemies there. There are lots of them, so prepare with lots of potions and weapons. The most ferocious enemy you will face there is a Scavenger Tyrant, so keep your wits about you and watch your back as you clear the area.

Once the coast is clear, head upstairs to pick up the What To Do With the Prisoners? lore page before making your way back downstairs and exiting through the doors on the western side of the building.

The Albaneve Summits Prison: What To Do With the Prisoners?

Turn left, and climb the metal grate on the outside of the building to reach the tower. Move inside and climb the staircases, keeping an eye on the cells on each floor. There is a skeleton in a cell on the second floor. Interact with it to retrieve Anton Godwin's soul and bring him back to your base. Use your summoning staff to introduce him to his new home and complete the quest.

articles.title: Doctor Doom Is Not a Tony Stark Variant in Avengers: Doomsday, Confirms Kevin Feige
articles.summary: Kevin Feige has confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Avengers: Doomsday.
articles.body:
Kevin Feige has confirmed that Doctor Doom is not a variant of Tony Stark in Avengers: Doomsday .

When speaking with Empire Magazine, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige debunked the popular fan theory that Doctor Doom and Tony Stark have a shared connection in the multiverse. Fans have speculated that Doom is a "variant" of Stark, since Robert Downey Jr. plays both characters . Variants are other versions of a character across the multiverse. We've seen this with the three Spider-Men, Wolverine, and Loki, so naturally, some fans thought this may all be an elaborate way to explain how Robert Downey Jr. is also playing Doom... turns out, it's not.

“Is Steve Rogers a Johnny Storm variant?" asked Feige. "People wondered, ‘Is Doom just a variant of another character? Is this just a shortcut to bringing back another character?’ The answer is no. He’s Victor Von Doom.”

Avengers: Doomsday Trailer: First Look at Doctor Doom

As for what Doom's whole deal is, the creative team behind the film teased what kind of energy he brings and why he is the way he is. The Russo Brothers, who are directing the film, teased that Doom has lost a child, is a "victim of trauma" and has a greater ego than Thanos. They also noted that he's a pretty terrifying presence.

"Doom is a Gothic character,” said director Joe Russo. “He says, ‘Hell answers to me,’ and he’s not kidding. He’s a very powerful character with some very dark magic, and he’s not above selling his soul to get what he wants. He’s worth being scared of.”

Robert Downey Jr. also noted that he was excited to lean into being a villain this time around, and suggested that Doom's plans have a tremendous scope to them.

"I like a bit of scorched earth,” teases Downey Jr. “Whatever you think he may be entertaining, I would ten times it, and you’ll probably be closer to the ballpark."

There's still a lot that we don't know about the film, which is just a little over a month away from being released. A recent listing on the WGA's website credited Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds for contributing to the film's script, which seems to suggest Wolverine and Deadpool may be in the film . Additionally, Marvel confirmed earlier this week that Scarlet Witch will also return in Avengers: Doomsday , though seemingly under the control of Doom himself.

Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18.

Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

articles.title: The Game Awards 2026 are Coming to Disney+
articles.summary: This year’s Game Awards are coming to Disney+, where it will broadcast in addition to its usual streams on Twitch and YouTube.
articles.body:
This year’s Game Awards are coming to Disney+, where it will broadcast in addition to its usual streams on Twitch and YouTube.

This partnership with Disney comes as the media monolith seeks to promote its roster of video games and game-related media projects, which Kingdom Hearts fans will note comes right on the heels of its big KH4 reveal at D23 earlier this year.

Reports from Variety state that this packed slate includes Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation, as well as Death Stranding Isolations , the forthcoming anime series based on Hideo Kojima’s Death Stranding franchise. The show got its first proper trailer in late October, alongside a first look at a full-length anime film set in the Death Stranding universe, Mosquito , which is set for a theatrical release on an as-yet unannounced date.

There are already a slew of strong contenders for this year’s Game Awards, the bulk of which you can read on IGN’s Biggest Games of 2026 Playlist . Resident Evil 9, 007: First Light, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake are just a few of the heavy hitters in an already packed slate — not to mention GTA 6, which will qualify for the Awards by the skin of its teeth after its arrival on November 19.

This marks the first time The Game Awards has been offered on Disney+, which continues to expand its reach after snagging Amazon’s Prime Video last year. The program will also stream on its official profiles on Twitch, YouTube, Instagram Live, TikTok, Steam, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Kick.

Somewhat ironically, the TGAs will take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. The show will air on Thursday, December 10 at 7:30pm ET / 4:30pm PT and will be hosted by Geoff Keighley.

Kingdom Hearts 4 Extended Gameplay Trailer | D23 2026

The Game Awards is always rife with exciting news, reveals, performances, and sometimes, even drama, as seen last year when comedian Andrew Schulz ruffled some feathers after calling out the cast of the Mortal Kombat movie . With some big games having already been announced, like Resident Evil: Veronica and The Witcher 4 , fans are more hopeful than ever that they'll get to see more of these titles at the year's most prestigious game awards event.

Nominees for The Game Awards are determined by a jury of more than 100 media outlets, journalists, and creators, including IGN. Winners are selected by vote, comprised of 90% voting jury and 10% fan votes .

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.body:
Echo Gem is an Item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake. This a new item, and serves as a replacement for the Stone of Agony and Shard of Agony from the other versions of the game. Rather than detecting grottos, Echo Gem detects Gold Skulltulas.

When equipped, an icon pings and flashes when a Gold Skulltula is nearby.

articles.title: The Dungeon Crawler Carl Books and Graphic Novels Are on Sale Before Black Friday
articles.body:
The Dungeon Crawler Carl series has really made the rounds this year. If you haven't already read the books or listened to the audiobooks , you've likely had someone recommend that you do. Matt Dinniman's crazy LitRPG story has already become a full-blown franchise in 2026 and we haven't even gotten the TV series yet.

Whether you've already read the books or not, Amazon is running a great sale right now that can help you collect all of the hardcovers at a significant discount. It's not Black Friday yet, but this '3 for 2's sale is the best time to buy the full collection at once.

Buy 2, Get 1 Free Dungeon Crawler Carl Hardcovers

Dungeon Crawler Carl, Vol. 1 (Graphic Novel)

Dungeon Crawler Carl, Vol. 2 (Graphic Novel)

Amazon has consistently been the best place to buy these books over the last few years and it's largely thanks to these types of sales. The '3 for 2' sale is stackable, so you can add any multiple of three to your cart and Amazon will discount the price of the cheapest items from your cart at checkout. Since there have only been eight books in the series so far, that means you'll need to add one more book to your cart to fully take advantage of this discount. Thankfully, both of the Dungeon Crawler Carl graphic novels are also included in the promotion.

As someone who has read the books and the graphic novels, I can honestly say they are both worth checking out. I was pretty worried I wouldn't like the graphic novel since I read the books before checking it out, but I was pleasantly surprised how different it felt. I gave it an 8 out of 10 in my review if you want to check that out.

Amazon's Black Friday Audible deal is great for the audiobook versions

Get 3 Months of Audible Standard for $0.99/mo

The '3 for 2' sale is great for fans who are looking for some merch to add to their shelves, but the Black Friday Audible deal is better for newcomers. The popularity of Dungeon Crawler Carl is, in no small part, thanks to some absolutely terrific audiobooks. Matt Dinniman himself has praised Jeff Hays' performance , saying he's one of the few narrators out there doing all of the voices and sound effects that make audiobooks more than just narration. The DCC audio versions are undoubtedly some of the best audiobooks available right now .

If you're new to the series, or just want to see what the audiobook hype is about, Amazon is running an Audible promo that's worth checking out. New (and some previous) subscribers can get the Audible Standard plan for only $0.99/month for the first three months, which includes one book per month. You'll also get a bonus $20 Audible credit to spend anything you want.

articles.title: Forever Waiting - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Forever Waiting is a quick Enshrouded quest that sends you to Everfore Keep, a well-guarded fortress in the Albaneve Summits. If you're looking for a way
articles.body:
Forever Waiting is a quick Enshrouded quest that sends you to Everfore Keep, a well-guarded fortress in the Albaneve Summits. If you're looking for a way to get into Everfore Keep or you want to know where to find the treasure on the tower, you'll find everything you need in this Enshrouded guide.

To get to Evermore Keep, fast travel to the Albaneve Summits Ancient Spire and soar off the northeastern side.

Drop down on the path, and start following it. You'll pass through an enshrouded area, the Gateway Outpost "Alba", the eventually find yourself in the Forge of Obsidia.

The Forge of Obsidia is actually the location of another quest, A Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith . Defeat enemies inside the main forge room until one of them drops the Bellows item. Tuck that away in your pack and use it to craft a Blast Furnace for the Blacksmith once you get back to your base!

For now, continue through the Forge by taking the doorway to the right and following that up a set of stairs. Turn left at the top of the stairs to get back outside again. Turn left as soon as you exit the building and continue following the path until you reach a dead-end.

Take a closer look at the cliff on your right to discover a cave entrance and a new path. Follow it until it branches and you can see some steel arches on the right. Take the path leading left, and continue following it to reach Evermore Keep.

Evermore Keep is locked up tight, so sneak around the traps to the locked door on the left and use a Lockpick to open it. Once you're in, head forward and go up the stairs to find yourself in a courtyard. Climb the stairs opposite and run up to a pile of rubble.

Turn left when you reach the rubble and follow the path around the side of the building to reach a grate. Climb the grate and run up the stairs on the left. Work your way around the grounds until you reach the highest tower. Once you do, head inside and go up the stairs.

Use the Grapple Point and look to your right to spot a lore page sitting on top of a desk called There's Too Much Paperwork!

From there, drop down the hole in the center of the room and read the next lore page at the bottom called We're on Break .

There's also another one on the shelf near the door leading outside called Follow-Up On the Request for Recruit Names .

Follow-Up On the Request for Recruit Names

Turn to face the west, and follow the halls until you pop back outside again. Follow the steps on the right around the building until you reach a pile of rubble.

Dig through that with your pickaxe to uncover the treasure and complete the Forever Waiting quest.

articles.title: The Lesser Twinflame Sword - Enshrouded Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The mission to retrieve the Lesser Twinflame Sword sends you to the depths of a Shroud-covered lake in the Albaneve Summits. Finding things in the Shroud can
articles.body:
The mission to retrieve the Lesser Twinflame Sword sends you to the depths of a Shroud-covered lake in the Albaneve Summits. Finding things in the Shroud can be particularly hard, so if you're struggling to find the Lonely Grave, you'll find everything you need to get there in this Enshrouded guide .

The Lonely Grave is an isolated burial site at the top of a massive rock overhanging Lake Luma in the Albaneve Summits. Lake Luma is in the northwestern portion of the Albaneve Summits, just northwest of the Event Honor Hall.

After passing the Event Honor Hall, keep following the path until you eventually spot an abandoned building with large, green, circular doors. Just opposite that building is a huge cliff overlooking Lake Luma.

If you investigate the Shroud, you will spot the tips of some towers just poking through the Shroud. That's the New Cromville settlement, where you can find Anton Godwin's Jester Hat . To the right of that is the Lonely Grave.

Leap off the cliff and aim for the Shroud's edge on the right. If you drop down in the right spot, you will find yourself on a large cliff overlooking the lake. If you just miss, you might find yourself on the lake itself. If so, run to the northern back, where you will find solid land.

Follow the hill up the edge of the wall to reach the top, where you'll encounter a few enemies. Take them out and approach the tip of the ledge. There, you will find the Lonely Grave. Equip a pickaxe and dig into the grave to retrieve the Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword .

articles.title: Charting the Unknown New Resources - Crimson Desert Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Charting the Unknown introduces many new ways for you to use resources for crafting in Crimson Desert. Whether that be for making new armor sets in the DLC, or
articles.body:
Charting the Unknown introduces many new ways for you to use resources for crafting in Crimson Desert. Whether that be for making new armor sets in the DLC, or creating and upgrading new ships for sailing the high seas, you will need to find new resources that were added to the game as part of this DLC.

Below you'll find a list of various difficult-to-find resources in the Charting the Unknown DLC, with dedicated pages to help you find each one, as well as an interactive map with each resource highlighted for you. All of these resources can be found underwater.

Many of these resources will be guarded by various moving stone creatures on the ocean floor. While you can attack them with your new harpoon gun, using Axiom Force will prove much more effective.

For the Stone Worms and Stone Crab-like-creatures, grab onto their Abyss Core with Axiom Force to instantly disable them.

For the anthropomorphic Stone Golems, grab their head with Axiom Force, and then hold one of the triggers to push or pull the head until the whole structure comes apart at once.

Dispatching these creatures quickly will give you time to look for the mineral you are looking for before you run out of breath. If you are running low, you can either swim to the surface, look for air bubbles to absorb, or you can catch a ride with a sun fish or turtle and borrow some nearby oxygen reserves while riding with them.

If you want to find one of the best ships in the DLC that you can craft using some of these resources, use this Phantom Ship Blueprint guide!

Golden Coral is a new resource that you can find and gather in Crimson Desert if you have the Charting the Unknown DLC . Golden Coral can be found underwater in specific locations. Use this guide page if you need help finding the various Golden Coral locations.

All Golden Coral Locations in Charting the Unknown

The interactive map below highlights all Golden Coral locations in Crimson Desert. Use this map for help finding the different places in Pywel where Golden Coral is located.

Golden Coral can be found in and amongst various Coral Reef locations on the ocean floor. If you find any Golden Coral, you should see it in large swaths - just look for the yellowy-golden broad leaves.

articles.body:
Beds and Shelter is an Enshrouded quest that tasks you with providing shelter for the farming assistant, Fenrig, so he can operate to his full potential. If you're wondering what exactly constitutes 'shelter' and how to create it, we've got everything you need to know in this Enshrouded guide.

So you've successfully completed the Bring Back the Pure Souls quest and got yourself a farming assistant to spice up your base. But Fenrig can't operate properly without some shelter! The first thing you need to get started is some sort of room. You will probably already have a decent base going by the time you rescue Fenrig.

But if not, the lands are full of ruins in Enshrouded, and if you don't have enough materials to craft a base from scratch, those places offer excellent base opportunities. Many of them will only require a little patching up, and they are good to go! Rookmore and Long Keep are great first base options!

If you're making a base or house for Fenrig from scratch, your first stop should be the workbench. There, you can craft building materials that you can use to create walls, floors, windows, and doors for your structure. Then, equip your Construction Hammer and select a floor tile. Lay out a base in whatever shape feels good for you, then craft some walls to border it.

Place a roof on top to complete your building. It doesn't even need a door to count as shelter, although adding one is a good idea. Once your structure is complete, craft a bed to place in there. The most basic bed option is the Crude Mattress, which you can craft using the following materials:

4x Torn Cloth: Found by defeating enemies.

4x Plant Fiber: Gathered from bushes and shrubbery.

Place your bed inside the structure, then use your Summoning Staff to summon Fenrig to the area. Click on the bed to assign it to him and complete your quest!

articles.summary: Natural Pearls are a new resource in Crimson Desert that you can find and gather in the ocean, if you have access to the Charting the Unknown DLC. Use this
articles.body:
Natural Pearls are a new resource in Crimson Desert that you can find and gather in the ocean, if you have access to the Charting the Unknown DLC . Use this guide page if you need help finding the various Natural Pearl locations.

All Natural Pearl Locations in Charting the Unknown

Below is an interactive map with all Natural Pearl locations listed to help you locate as many Natural Pearls as you might need.

Natural Pearls can usually be found in sheltered locations, either inside underwater structures or underneath larger outcroppings along the ocean floor.

They emit a strong glow (similar to that of jellyfish) which can be used to help locate them in dark areas. Smaller jellyfish can be seen gathered around them, and you can simply harvest them by interacting with the pearls when up close.

Visit the Charting the Unknown New Resources page for help with finding other difficult-to-find resources, like Golden Coral, Ambergris, and more!

All Sea Fan Coral Locations in Charting the Unknown

Below is an interactive map that has every Sea Fan Coral location highlighted on it to help you find as much Sea Fan Coral as you could need in Crimson Desert.

How to Find Sea Fan Coral in Charting the Unknown

Sea Fan Coral can found in Coral Reef locations in Crimson Desert, along the ocean floor. You'll usually find Sea Fan Coral in clusters, and you can spot it from its silver-white appearance. It mostly resembles silver/white seaweed.

articles.title: Where to Get Ambergris - Crimson Desert Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Ambergris is a new material that you can find in Crimson Desert that was introduced as part of the Charting the Unknown DLC. You can find Ambergris underwater
articles.body:
Ambergris is a new material that you can find in Crimson Desert that was introduced as part of the Charting the Unknown DLC . You can find Ambergris underwater along the ocean floor. Use this guide page for help with finding the various Ambergris locations.

All Ambergris Locations in Charting the Unknown

Below is a map with every Ambergris location highlighted to help you find as much Ambergris as you could need.

Ambergris is a rare resource in Crimson Desert that can be found near giant whale bones along the floor of the ocean. Ambergris is a real-world by-product produced by sperm whales, and that is reflected here with the locations of Ambergris being tied to large whale bones under the ocean.

Ambergris looks like an amber mineral deposit in a rock formation, and it needs to be mined before it can be collected. You can do this underwater with a pickaxe, drill arm, or Force Palm.

articles.body:
Hydrothermal Mineral Deposits are a resource in Crimson Desert that was introduced as part of the Charting the Unknown DLC . These deposits can be found on the ocean floor. Use this guide page to help you find this resource for various crafting purposes.

All Hydrothermal Mineral Deposit Locations in Charting the Unknown

Below is a map that has every Hydrothermal Mineral Deposit location highlighted to help you find as much of this resource as you might need.

How to Find Hydrothermal Mineral Deposits in Charting the Unknown

Hydrothermal Mineral Deposits can be found along the ocean floor in Crimson Desert if you have the Charting the Unknown DLC. Some areas of the ocean feature gaseous vents that damage the player if they go near them. These vents emit a yellow substance, along with what looks like smoke, into the water.

Near these vents are dark lumps of stone that have glowing orange veins throughout. Use a mining tool (or Force Palm) to break these lumps, and you can then gather the deposits for your own uses.
